U.S. COMMERCIAL PROPERTY PRICE INDEX®​

"Waiting For Price Clarity"

Newport Beach, CA, October 6, 2026 — The Green Street Commercial Property Price Index® decreased 0.1% in September. Over the past twelve months, the index has increased 4.7%.

“If this rise in yields sticks, property prices are likely to go down,” said Peter Rothemund, Co-Head of Strategic Research at Green Street. “I think the question people are asking now is ‘how much’. That’s hard to say, but pricing for sectors with solid fundamentals is likely to hold up better than pricing in sectors with limited growth.”
